WITH store_data AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as store_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as store_receipts
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
web_data AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as web_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) as web_orders
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
    AND fwo.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0) as total_net_sales,
  COALESCE(s.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0) as total_transactions,
  ROUND((COALESCE(s.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0)) / 
    (COALESCE(s.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0)), 2) as atv
FROM store_data s, web_data w

WITH store_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as store_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as store_receipts
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_period
),
web_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as web_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) as web_orders
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
    AND fwo.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dd.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_period, w.fiscal_period) as fiscal_period,
  COALESCE(s.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0) as net_sales,
  COALESCE(s.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0) as transactions,
  ROUND((COALESCE(s.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0)) / 
    (COALESCE(s.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0)), 2) as atv
FROM store_by_period s
FULL OUTER JOIN web_by_period w ON s.fiscal_period = w.fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period
